title: cardamine hirsuta f. litoralis
intro: Cardamine hirsuta f. litoralis, commonly known as sea bittercress, is a plant species of the family Brassicaceae. It is a type of wild plant known for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Cardamine hirsuta f. litoralis include glucosinolates, which are compounds that may have therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects.
